en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Yahya b. Musawir from Fudhayl al-Ghassan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
One who recites Surah Anbiya with sincerity to it, would be among the companions of all the prophets in Paradise. While in the world he would carry much prestige and awe among the people.
